title: Verso — open-source agent orchestrator for knowledge work
excerpt: Verso connects to your apps, remembers your context, and orchestrates local Hermes agents on your Mac.
content_html:
A free, open-source, agent orchestrator that gets things done.

Verso is an easy and intuitive macOS app that makes it trivial for non-technical folks to leverage the frontier of AI to get things done. Free and open-source. Built on Hermes Agent.

Catch me up on the board conversation.

Read 32 messages in #board-q3

Found 2 threads — “Board update”

Opened “Q3 board deck — draft”

Board call — Thursday, 10:00

You’re mostly caught up. Ana shared the Q3 numbers yesterday — revenue landed 8% above plan — and the one open question is the hiring budget. Marc asked everyone to confirm the two new roles before Thursday’s call.

Built for simplicity

Everything you need.
Nothing you don't.

Memory that stays home.

Verso keeps a working memory of what’s around you — meetings, threads, documents — in a plain database on your Mac so that it has full context of what you are working on.

Connected to your work.

Link the apps you already use — mail, calendar, notes, tasks, chat — or any tool that speaks MCP. Ask once, and Verso reads across them and acts: drafts the reply, updates the doc, files the task.

The best models, one place.

Frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic, switchable mid-conversation without losing context. Sign in with the accounts you already have.

How it works

A simple orchestrator.

Built on Hermes.

Hermes is one of the most trusted agent harnesses out there; used by engineering teams, tinkerers, and artists at the frontier. Verso wraps it in a native MacOS app, making it trivial for non-technical audiences to get the most out of it.

Oh, and both are open source.

Try it out.

It's yours.

Download for Mac
